name: Time's Up! Turn the Page
source:
Cassandra has just graduated from high school but has no idea what she’ll do next! Will she be able to come up with a plan before times up and the next chapter of her life begins?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25900]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
卡珊德拉剛剛高中畢業，卻完全不知道接下來該做什麼！在時間耗盡、人生下一章開啟之前，她能想出一個計畫嗎？

［譯自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25900]Lemma Soft論壇[/url]］
